scope: Owner-approved local manual pilot extension of Batch 45 Professional Code Authoring from three to six real non-mechanical code tasks in codex_docs.

tasks.title: Professional Code automation candidates require three manual successful runs
tasks.change_summary: Added a Professional Code Authoring threshold of 3 manual runs, exposed the threshold in the report and normalized underscore candidate identifiers.
tasks.real_gap_found: Generic two-run manual stability was too weak for Batch 45 Professional Code Authoring automation candidates.
tasks.review_comment: A reviewer would catch that Professional Code automation needs a higher evidence bar than generic candidates.

tasks.title: Empty first-run Professional Code Authoring summary uses not_applicable
tasks.change_summary: Aligned the empty Professional Code Authoring summary with the existing allowed status vocabulary by using not_applicable instead of not_available.
tasks.real_gap_found: Empty summary bypassed the normal status vocabulary and could blur not-applicable versus missing-data semantics.
tasks.review_comment: A reviewer would catch status vocabulary drift before generated artifacts rely on ambiguous values.

tasks.title: Self-learning Professional Code candidates may target handoff-completeness eval
tasks.change_summary: Added the existing handoff-completeness eval template to the Professional Code Authoring candidate-only allowed update targets.
tasks.real_gap_found: Professional Code Authoring can surface handoff issues, but the candidate allow-list omitted the existing handoff-completeness eval.
tasks.review_comment: A reviewer would catch scope completeness, but this is less urgent than safety or activation-policy drift.

tasks.title: Failed manual runs block Professional Code automation stability
tasks.change_summary: Added manual failure parsing, surfaced manual_failure_count in the report and made Professional Code manual stability require 3 successes with zero failures.
tasks.real_gap_found: Three successes with an observed failure could previously look stable enough for candidate reporting.
tasks.review_comment: A reviewer would catch that success-count-only gates are misleading for automation promotion.

tasks.title: Professional Code regression flags accept human-spaced aliases
tasks.change_summary: Normalized spaces in Professional Code signal detection so human-readable regression flags like coding standards comment noise create candidate-only packets.
tasks.real_gap_found: Human-spaced Professional Code regression flags were missed because only hyphen and underscore variants were normalized.
tasks.review_comment: A reviewer would catch taxonomy alias drift where humans write labels differently from code constants.

tasks.title: Self-Learning candidate evidence references are privacy-safe
tasks.change_summary: Sanitized candidate evidence and feedback references so local absolute paths and private references become redacted markers before validation and persistence.
tasks.real_gap_found: Candidate packets could carry local absolute evidence paths or email-like private references before the validator rejected them, creating fragile reporting behavior.
tasks.review_comment: A reviewer would catch privacy-safe evidence handling before learning-loop artifacts store raw local or personal references.
